component.name: Okapi
component.summary: A desktop chat client for local and cloud LLM inference backends

description.p: okapi is a desktop chat client for agentic work. It talks to local inference servers (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) and cloud APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral AI, OpenRouter, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint), locally or on remote machines.

ul.li: Streaming chat over Server-Sent Events with live token throughput (t/s)
Reasoning models: thinking phases shown as collapsible elements in the chat

MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration: connect HTTP/SSE or stdio servers and use their tools, resources and prompts, with per-tool permissions (off / ask / allow); tool calls and results are shown inline in the chat
File attachments: images, PDFs, office documents, archives, e-mails and text files, with thumbnail previews and automatic text extraction (Poppler, Tesseract OCR, libarchive; optional at build time)
Speech-to-text dictation with live transcription while you speak
Text-to-speech: assistant responses can be read aloud, synthesized sentence-by-sentence while the response streams in
Prompt templates, insertable via slash commands in the composer
Chat history grouped by date in the sidebar; everything stored locally in an SQLite database in the XDG data directory; messages can be edited and resent
KDE Plasma look & feel, works on GNOME and other desktops; follows freedesktop standards (XDG desktop entry)
